en.title: State Funds Boost Wheelchair Accessibility in Kern County Facilities
en.summary: A state commission will allocate thousands of dollars to improve wheelchair accessibility across Kern County facilities. Advances in hearing aid and cochlear implant technology expand options for people with hearing loss. Additionally, a new smart toilet robot moves autonomously to assist users with disabilities.

highlights.title: State commission to allocate thousands to boost Kern County’s wheelchair accessibility

zh-TW.title: 州委員會撥款改善肯恩縣輪椅無障礙設施
zh-TW.summary: 州委員會將撥出數千美元，改善肯恩縣的輪椅無障礙設施。助聽器與人工耳蝸技術進步，為聽力障礙者提供更多選擇。此外，一款智能馬桶機器人能自行移動至使用者身旁，協助殘障人士。
